title: GHOST TRACK update 11/22: ship cameras, staff officers and rudimentary sounds.
author: _Fauxpaw
selftext:
GHOST TRACK is a space fleet game where you run intelligence for a battlefleet through CRT consoles and camera feeds. Reports can be wrong, so you send cameras to look and visually confirm things.

*New this week*:

\- **Multicam**: Warships now have multiple camera points on them, which you can switch between.

\- **Multispot**: Multiple spot monitors now exist instead of just one.

\- **Patchboard**: run cords to pick which camera show on which spot.

\- **Staff Officers**: The Threat Analyst and Recon & Drone staff officers now exist. The TA works your Alert queue, one at a time, and proposes a choice of action among those available. You can also ask your TA about something and they will prioritize it. The Recon & Drone officer adds to your Alert queue by claiming cameras and piloting them out to look at signals and visually confirm them for you.

\- **Drone Limits**: Fly a drone out of range and it loses its link. Then it blows itself up on a timer, so it can't be claimed by the enemy.

\- **Chase Default**: The Chase camera is now the default camera for a ship.

\- **First Sounds**: key clicks, a captain's beep as an order is acknowledged, and the thump of your guns and of hits. They are stand-ins for now.
